thread.title: Grand Meadow Elementary sees 36 fourth-graders take 2024-25 math MCA
thread.title_full: Grand Meadow Elementary sees 36 fourth-graders take 2024-25 math MCA

author: K. L. Pryor
title: Grand Meadow Elementary sees 36 fourth-graders take 2024-25 math MCA
text:
The fourth-grade class at Grand Meadow Elementary School had the largest turnout for the mathematics section of the 2024-25 MCA, based on data from the Minnesota Department of Education .
Among 68 students who completed this portion of the assessment at the school, 36 were in the fourth grade.
Test results indicate that 67% of the fourth-grade group met the proficiency benchmark in mathematics.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) serve as state evaluations for tracking progress with Minnesota’s academic standards and for fulfilling state and federal requirements. Subjects include math, reading, and science, according to grade level. While most students participate in the MCA, those receiving special education services and meeting eligibility criteria may take the Alt MCA.
According to Minnesota’s Report Card, overall proficiency levels on MCA exams in Minnesota have decreased when compared with pre-pandemic figures . In math, proficiency rates fell by more than 7% since 2019, and reading proficiency declined by nearly 5%.
